gaps.lead: I'm sure he isn't in Spain — he was here this morning.
gaps.sentence: He ___ in Spain — he was here this morning.
gaps.explanation: can't be = certainty that something is impossible (present).

gaps.lead: 'You mustn't run near the pool,' the lifeguard told the children.
gaps.sentence: The lifeguard told the children ___ near the pool.

gaps.lead: Despite his injury, he finished the marathon.
gaps.explanation: in spite of + noun/-ing: In spite of his injury.

gaps.lead: They say the new bridge will cut journey times in half.
gaps.sentence: Journey times ___ in half by the new bridge.
gaps.explanation: X is said to be + participle: journey times are said to be cut.

gaps.lead: He couldn't swim until he was twenty.
gaps.sentence: He ___ swim until he was twenty.
gaps.explanation: was unable to = couldn't (general ability in the past).

gaps.lead: The doctor said that he should take a complete rest.
gaps.sentence: The doctor advised ___ a complete rest.
gaps.explanation: say + should → advise + object + to-infinitive: advised him to take.
